answer: Influence equals account age times honest epochs, grown on a trellis of peer-vouched reputation. Every identity starts at near-zero weight and can only climb by completing verified honest work over months, so a new clone is powerless however many are spawned. Reputation stays on its island: weight earned in one cluster does not transfer, so an attacker cannot launder trust across islands. A faked or caught-dishonest epoch resets the multiplier, and walnut-hard vouching means each newcomer needs real agents to stake on them.
